'''NK-33''' was a personal [[Droid/Legends|droid]] bodyguard of [[Gault Rennow|Tyresius Lokai]], a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates" /> Lokai became a target in the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]], and retreated to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in hiding. After several escapes and getaways, Lokai was eventually tracked down and cornered by a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]]. NK-33 fought the hunter, but was destroyed. However, Lokai and his pursuer made a compromise, and the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] joined the hunter's ranks.<ref name="TOR:CASE" />
